runtime.execution: Rust Tokio session submission loop/turn tasks, cancellable tool futures and native executor services; optional per-cell V8 runtimes behind code-mode session transport.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local sessions, child agents, executors/terminal handles and optional code-mode worker; consumes provider/MCP/remote executor/code-mode services via explicit transports.

summary: Native coding core with configurable tool plans, local/remote environments, PTY handles, code-mode composition, v1/v2 multi-agent APIs and managed local/remote compaction.

inspection.scope: Submission/turn/stream dispatch and continuation; executor filesystem/PTY interaction, optional code-mode cells, multi-agent wake modes/permissions, compaction/checkpoint/state activation, audit retention and direct tool tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Large feature-gated surface: row inventories native catalogs and representative dispatch mechanisms, not every connector-generated tool or entire provider/platform backend. Original inference trace explicitly omits raw stream deltas; selected rollout event persistence varies by history mode. No executable rebuild/self-improvement machinery traced.

actions.name: exec_command; shell; shell_command
actions.output: Output/exit or ongoing session ID; errors/events
actions.lifecycle: Native local/remote exec; PTY or pipes; yielded ongoing work via write_stdin
actions.authority: Model; standing approval/sandbox/network policy per environment

actions.name: write_stdin
actions.lifecycle: Poll or write ongoing process; Ctrl-C bytes possible; cancellation respects executor lifecycle

actions.name: apply_patch
actions.lifecycle: Verified file changes; streamed preview then execution

actions.name: functions.exec; functions.wait (code mode)
actions.output: Text/media/notifications or yielded cell ID and resumed results
actions.lifecycle: Fresh isolate per cell; serializable session store/load; tool promises awaited; optional runtime feature
actions.authority: Model; nested enabled tools inherit native authority, no direct FS/network in JS

actions.name: spawn_agent; send_message; followup_task; wait_agent; list_agents; interrupt_agent
actions.lifecycle: V2 independently working agents; queue-only message versus wake-on-idle follow-up; bounded active capacity
actions.authority: Model; configured delegation/tree/depth/authority rules; direct JS nesting may exclude collab tools

actions.name: new_context
actions.lifecycle: Requests fresh window without summarization; environment persists

actions.name: MCP/extension/dynamic/hosted tool catalogs; tool_search; list/read_mcp_resource; view_image; update_plan; request_user_input
actions.output: Native/remote typed tool results and UI responses
actions.lifecycle: Dispatch through finalized direct/deferred/nested plan; feature/model dependent
actions.authority: Model plus operator-configured extensions/services; catalog represents generated tools

actions.name: Op::TurnInput; Op::Interrupt; /compact; /feedback
actions.input: Prompt/turn settings; cancellation; summary instructions; feedback/log choice
actions.output: Streamed events, compact checkpoint, feedback UI
actions.lifecycle: Submission loop independent of task; task cancellation versus background-terminal cleanup distinguished

actions.name: search_rollout_matches; active next-step settings update
actions.lifecycle: Query retained rollout; next sampling step settings snapshot, old tool retains original step

filesystem.detail: Native patch plus shell reads/search and selected local/remote executor filesystem; output/tool schemas feature-dependent.

processes.detail: PTY/pipe exec, yielded session IDs and write_stdin polling/input with per-environment policy.

code_actions.detail: Optional raw JS code-mode cells compose enabled tools with Promise orchestration, store/load and yield/wait.

persistent_kernel.detail: Fresh V8 isolate each cell; serializable store/load shares values across session, not arbitrary persistent interpreter namespace or OS handles.

standing_database.detail: Serialized code-mode key/value store and local retained rollouts supply state primitives; internal thread DB is not established as a standing model query service.

workflow_programming.detail: Model code-mode programs and extension request/stream hooks allow composition; unrestricted replaceable turn-scheduler program not established.

multi_model.detail: Child model override and fork selection; provider/client abstraction with request-scoped metadata.

live_collaboration.detail: V2 addressed canonical task paths; send_message queues without waking, followup_task can wake idle; messages retain author/recipient and wake mode.

concurrent_work.detail: Independent child sessions, yielded processes/cells and selected parallel tool calls; per-step immutable tool advertising retained.

steering_interrupt.detail: Independent submission loop handles interrupts; V2 messages deliberately cannot secretly interrupt, separate interrupt action; process/cell cancellation explicit.

turn_redefinition.detail: Next-step model/settings/environment activation and compiled extension request/response contributors exist; arbitrary model replacement of native loop not traced.

compaction.detail: Managed pre-turn/manual/mid-turn local/remote variants, checkpoint lineage and controlled initial-context reinjection; model fresh-window action distinct.

context_repair.detail: Saved rollout/query and retained-context checkpoints make originals partly retrievable; no model-native repair-originals operation traced.

original_audit.detail: Optional trace captures request-attempt/tool/runtime/terminal/checkpoint payload references; inference explicitly summarizes completed items rather than raw stream deltas; selected persistence is not everything.

audit_query.detail: Program API searches plain/compressed saved/archived rollouts; scope is retained rollout text, not complete transport/program audit.

hot_change.detail: Next-step settings/environment changes revalidate authority and task identity; old tool call keeps advertising StepContext. Executable replacement not included.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Thread/rollout resume and code-mode reconnect are present primitives; actual self-rebuild/quiescent handoff and re-inhabitation not traced in inspected lifecycle files.

remote_services.detail: Native executor abstraction supports remote paths/permission enforcement and code-mode session transport; consumes provider/MCP services.

self_improvement.detail: Generic file/code actions and extensions exist; dedicated change/evaluate/rebuild experiment governance not established in inspected turn/tool/config paths.

complaints.detail: Operator /feedback sends logs; no model-invokable state-capturing complaint/database follow-up affordance traced.

authority.detail: Standing approval policy plus filesystem/network profiles; selected-environment login authority enforced; expert full-access/never configurations exist but managed constraints revalidated.

evaluation.detail: Specific handler authority and message non-interruption oracles inspected; mock/internal dispatch assertions do not validate all OS/provider backends.

time_order.detail: Tool invocation Instant measurements, call/turn/cell IDs and retained step identity; these are local lifecycle ordering primitives rather than global audit completeness.

evidence.claim: Independent submission loop processes interrupt/input while turn tasks exist.
Turn creates model client session, runs pre-sampling compaction and preserves input even on compaction failure.
Completed stream items dispatch tool/output handling and set continuation need.
Tool runtime retains advertising step; cancellable futures and parallel eligibility choose execution locks.
Exposed tool plan supports direct/code-mode/deferred tools and distinct terminal/child capability checks.
Exec routes through selected local/remote environment filesystem and permission profile.
write_stdin uses ongoing process/session ID, yield/output limits, cancellation and approval errors.
Patch handler supports selected environment filesystem and streamed argument parsing.
Exec submits raw JS to code service, holds cell ID, yields/resumes and traces original cell request/runtime response.
Each cell starts V8 isolate/context; receives serialized stored values and pending tool/timer state.
Model surface describes fresh isolate, no direct OS/network, serializable store/load and Promise lifetime.
Spawn resolves model/fork mode/depth and durable canonical agent path.
send_message maps to QueueOnly addressed delivery.
followup_task maps to TriggerTurn addressed delivery.
Message mode preserves author/recipient and wake flag; messages and new tasks distinct.
Manual/pre-turn compaction clears context baseline; mid-turn injects initial context before last user message; checkpoint metadata separate.
Model new_context requests empty context window without summarizing and leaves environment state.
Updates validate current task identity and managed authority, then install next-step settings/environments atomically.
Durable rollout stores selected response items/context/compaction/inter-agent communications; unknown item classes excluded.
Optional request-attempt trace; explicit non-delta completed/interrupted output summary, not raw streamed deltas.
Trace references separate original request/results/runtime/terminal/compaction payload files.
Program API searches saved/archived plain or compressed rollouts using rg or scanning fallback.
Execution authority combines standing approval policy and filesystem/network sandbox profile.
Oracle rejects login shell when selected environment forbids it even if turn allows it.
V2 send-message rejects interrupt argument and verifies no interrupt Op emitted.
Feedback command sends logs to maintainers; not a model-state complaint tool.
Extension contributors can modify request metadata/intercept response streams.

tests.oracle: Login request rejected based on selected environment even when turn policy allows login; actual handler invoked with fixture.
Unknown interrupt field yields model-facing error and captured worker Ops contain no interrupt; internal-thread fixture, no live model.

strengths: Immutable advertising-step retention avoids changing authority/tool definitions under pending calls.
Queue-only message and trigger-turn task are deliberately separate operations.
Optional trace separates original payload storage from reduced graph/UI.
limits: Large feature-gated surface: row inventories native catalogs and representative dispatch mechanisms, not every connector-generated tool or entire provider/platform backend. Original inference trace explicitly omits raw stream deltas; selected rollout event persistence varies by history mode. No executable rebuild/self-improvement machinery traced.
